result.analyst_notes: Aspirational and purpose-led, using first-person plural and absolute phrasing ('every person', 'we believe'). Community and a better world lead, with stakeholders named mainly in one list. Metaphor and section headings dominate; concrete commitments are sparse. The 118-year history is descriptive, and the sustainability report link is site chrome.
